user_story: As a user, I want to see my profile information after logging in so that I can confirm my account details.

positive.title: Successful login and display of profile information
steps: Wait for the profile page to load.
positive.expected_result: User profile information is displayed accurately, including username and account details.

negative.title: Login attempt with invalid credentials
steps: Enter an invalid username and/or password.
negative.expected_result: User is presented with an error message indicating incorrect login details, and profile page is not accessed.

edge.title: Login with valid credentials but profile information is incomplete
steps: Wait for the profile page to load with deliberately missing profile information.
edge.expected_result: Profile page loads but with warning/message indicating incomplete profile information or empty fields for the missing details.
